hook.name: HHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a reserve-backed floor price for the H token. On exact-input sells below RFV, beforeSwap intercepts the swap, burns the H, and pays ETH from the treasury at RFV. A 5% swap tax is applied via afterSwap (burning H on buys, routing ETH to treasury on sells). Also mints epoch-based staking rewards on each swap.
